spans.s: 1. द्यु cl. 2. P. द्यौति (Dhātup. xxiv, 31; pf. दुद्याव, 3. pl. दुद्युवुर्) to go against, attack, assail, Bhaṭṭ.
2. द्यु॑ for 3. दिव् as inflected stem and in comp. before consonants.

1. द्युत् mfn. advancing against, (ifc.), ib.

2. द्युत् cl. 1. Ā. द्यो॑तते, AV.; MBh. (also ˚ति) &c. (pf. दिद्युते, p. ˚तान॑, RV. [cf. Pāṇ. vii, 4, 67], दिद्यो॑त, AV.; ˚द्युतुर्, TS.; aor. अद्युतत् and अ॑दिद्युतत्, Br.; अ॑द्यौत्, RV.; Br., अद्योतिष्ट, Pāṇ. i, 3, 91; iii, 1, 55, Kāś. p. P. द्युतत् Ā. ˚तान॑ or द्यु॑तान, RV.; fut. द्योतिष्यति, Br.; ind.p. द्युतित्वा or द्योत्˚, Pāṇ. i, 2, 26, Kāś.; -द्युत्य, AitBr.)
to shine, be bright or brilliant:
Caus. द्योतयति (˚ते, Bhaṭṭ.) to make bright, illuminate, irradiate, MBh.; Kāv.;
to cause to appear, make clear or manifest, express, mean, ṢaḍvBr.; Lāṭy.; Śaṃk.; Sāh. :
Desid. दिद्युतिषते or दिद्योत्˚, Pāṇ. i, 2, 26, Kāś. :
Intens. द॑विद्योत्, 3. pl. ˚द्युतति, RV.; AV.; Br.;
 देद्युत्यते, Pāṇ. vii, 4, 67, Kāś., to shine, glitter, be bright or brilliant
3. द्यु॑त् f. shining, splendour, ray of light, RV.; MBh. &c. (cf. दन्त-).
3.4. द्युत् Caus. द्योतयति, to break, tear open, AV. iv, 23, 5 (cf. अभिवि-, आ-).
